title: Why did Trump back Jensen Huang's return?
summary: Jensen Huang is back as the CEO of Nvidia, with the help of Trump, despite a flurry of ongoing investigations. Is he too big to fail?

image.caption: FILE PHOTO: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and U.S. President Donald Trump shake hands at an 'Investing in America' event in Washington, D.C., U.S., April 30, 2025. REUTERS/Leah Millis/File Photo (REUTERS)

blocks.text: Jensen Huang is back as the CEO of Nvidia, with the help of Trump, despite a flurry of ongoing investigations. Is he too big to fail?
Front Burner22:22Why did Trump back Jensen Huang's return?
On Monday, Nvidia's Jensen Huang returned as CEO to the company that scandal had drummed him out of. His return was met with cheers at the company’s headquarters.

His resurrection was far from a strictly internal company decision. Donald Trump admitted, on CNBC, that he had a hand in bringing Huang back despite his multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence asset.

Ashley Gold is a senior tech correspondent at Semafor. She joins us to talk about what it means when one of the world's most powerful men, intervenes on behalf of a corporate titan, to prop up a company that underpins a huge swath of the global economy.
